title: U.S. students' "reading recession" continuing but some places bucking the trend, report shows

title: Okyeame Kwame turns TGMA27 red carpet moment into anti

title: Partners officially launch the Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park Project, strengthening long-term transboundary conservation and community resilience
desc: Partners launched the Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park (KTP) Project, a new European Union‑funded initiative aimed at strengthening biodiversity conservation, protected area management and community resilience across one of southern Africa’s most significant transboundary landscapes. Partial funding for the project was also provided by the Dezzy Foundation through the Global Wildlife Fund.
